description: This file contains tutorial code demonstrating how to compute Jacobians and Hessians using functorch in PyTorch, including performance comparisons and batch computations.

methods.name: predict
methods.description: Computes a linear transformation followed by a tanh activation.

methods.name: compute_jac
methods.description: Calculates the Jacobian of the predict function with respect to input x.

methods.name: predict_with_output_summed
methods.description: Sums the output of predict over the batch dimension for batch Jacobian computation.
